evidence: All new spend multipliers are bounded before dispatch: handoffs are below 4,000 tokens; elapsed time, sessions, total tokens, and uncached input have strict ceilings; equality or missing usage stops; the Design sweep, acceptance outcomes, producer-edge proofs, and Fix/Evaluate cycles have fixed counts. Active usage is counted, concurrent starts are CAS-screened, detailed session telemetry is minimized after finalization, and no new billable infrastructure, unbounded model loop, high-cardinality telemetry, or growing unowned store is proposed.
